description: Import an already reviewed caption artifact into the active sequence, or create a local lecture-caption timing and review workflow plan. Import rejects unsupported formats before host dispatch and reports structural success only when valid count readback shows exactly one new caption track. Unreadable or unexpected results preserve committed_unverified diagnostics; inspect before retrying. The planning action never contacts Premiere or changes an artifact.

action.description: Use import (the default) to create a Premiere caption track, or plan_lecture_workflow for a read-only SRT/VTT timing and review plan.

allow_proportional_scaling.description: For plan_lecture_workflow, explicitly permit a bounded timing-scale preview when the artifact end does not match target_duration_seconds. This still never rewrites a caption artifact.

artifact_format.description: For plan_lecture_workflow, the syntax of caption_content. VTT content must include its WEBVTT header.

caption_content.description: For plan_lecture_workflow, the caller-owned SRT or VTT content to parse locally. The returned plan contains no caption text and does not write this artifact.

caption_format.description: For action import, Premiere caption format: subtitle (default), 608, 708, teletext, ebu, op42, or op47.

expected_cep_target.description: Optional reviewed CEP sequence/clip identity and exact tick ranges. Checked before every generated command; UXP refuses this CEP-only guard.

effect.description: Reviewed effect and parameter identity checked before mutation.

match_name.description: Effect match name from host inspection.

end_ticks.description: Exact expected exclusive timeline end ticks.

out_ticks.description: Exact expected exclusive source Out ticks.

track_index.description: Expected zero-based track index; identity still checked.

project_document_id.description: Exact Premiere project document ID observed during review.

source_item.description: Reviewed source identity for a source-only operation.

expected_project_path.description: Optional absolute saved-project path. Every generated CEP command refuses before its body when the active project differs or is unsaved. UXP commands refuse this CEP-only guard; local-only tools do not inspect Premiere. Omit to keep existing behavior.

item_id.description: For action import, the node ID or name of the imported caption project item (for example, an SRT file). Omit for plan_lecture_workflow.

observed_offset_seconds.description: For plan_lecture_workflow, an editor-observed constant offset in seconds. Positive means captions currently appear later than intended; the preview proposes the inverse shift when safe.

start_seconds.description: For action import, offset in seconds from the start of the sequence (default: 0).

target_duration_seconds.description: For plan_lecture_workflow, optional intended sequence duration. A mismatch requires review unless proportional scaling is explicitly authorized.

timing_tolerance_seconds.description: For plan_lecture_workflow, tolerance used to classify an offset or duration mismatch (default: 0.25 seconds).

name: create_caption_track

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true; on failure, diagnostic detail when the tool provides it.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

receipt.description: Versioned common mutation receipt; success never implies rendered verification.
